spans.s: a. [अघ्-कर्तरि अच्] 1 Bad, sinful, evil, wicked; अघायुरिन्द्रियारामो मोघं पार्थ स जीवति [[

.]] 
-घम् [अघ् भावे अच्] 
__1 Sin; अघं स केवलं भुङ्क्ते यः पचत्यात्मकारणात् [[

]]; अघौघविध्वंसविधौ पटीयसीः [[Śi. 1. 18]], हरत्यघं सम्प्रति हेतुरेष्यतः 26; °मर्षण &c.; misdeed, fault, crime; श्रेयान् द्विजातिरिव हन्तुमघानि दक्षम् [[Śi. 4. 37]] sins and griefs also. 
__2 An evil, mishap, misfortune, accident, injury, harm; न वधूष्वघानि विमृशन्ति धियः [[
]] do not think of doing harm or evil; क्रियादघानां मघवा विघातम् 3. 52; अघोपघातं मघवा विभूत्यै 11. 80; प्रजानां तमघावहम् [[

]]; न वर्धयेदघाहानि 84. न राज्ञामघदोषोऽस्ति 93; 
__4 Pain, suffering, grief, distress; उपप्लुतमघौघेन नात्मानमवबुद्धयसे [[

]] not subject to grief. 
__5 Passion. cf. अंहोदुःखव्यसनेष्वघम् [[Nm.]] 
-घः N. of a demon, brother of Baka and Pūtanā and commander-in-chief of Kaṃsa. [Being sent by Kaṃsa to Gokula to kill Kṛṣṇa and Balarāma he assumed the form of a huge serpent 4 yojanas long, and spread himself on the way of the cowherds, keeping his horrid mouth open. The cowherds mistook it for a mountain cavern and entered it, cows and all. But Kṛṣṇa saw it, and having entered the mouth so stretched himself that he tore it to pieces and rescued his companions.] 
-घा The Goddess of sin; (pl.) the constellation usually called Maghā. 
-Comp. 
-असुरः See अघ above. 
-अहः (अहन्) a day of impurity (अशौ चदिनम्) 
-आयुस् a. leading a wicked life. 
-कृव् a. sinful, wicked, evil-doer. 
-घ्नः = °नाशन. 
-नाशा, -नाशान a. [अघं नाशयति] expiatory, destroying sin (such as gifts, muttering holy prayers &c.). 
(-नः) destroyer of the demon अघ; N. of Kṛṣṇa. 
-भोजिन् a. [अघं पापफलकं भुङ्क्ते] a sinful eater (one who cooks and eats for his own sake and not for Gods, Manes guests &c). 
-मर्षण a. [अघं मृष्यते उत्पन्नत्वेऽपि नाशनेन कर्माक्षमत्वात् सह्यते अनेन मृष्-ल्युट्] expiatory, removing or destroying sin, usually applied to a prayer (सन्ध्या) repeated by Brāhmaṇas (the 190th hymn of [[

.]]); सर्वैनसामपध्बंसि जप्यं त्रिष्वघमर्षणं [[Ak.]]; यथाश्वमेधः क्रतुराट् सर्वपापापनोदनः । तथाघमर्षणं सूक्तं सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् ॥ The most heinous crimes, such as illicit intercourse with a preceptor's wife, one's own mother, sister, daughter-in-law &c. are said to be expiated by repeating this [Page0021-2] सूक्त thrice in water; पवित्राण्यघमर्षणानि जपन्त्याम् [[

]], 38. 
-मार a. [अघं मारयति नाशयति; मृ णिच्-अण्] destroying sin, an epithet of Gods (यमो मृत्युरघमारो निरृतः). 
-रुद् a. [अघं रोदिति स्वकर्माक्षमतया यस्मात्, रुद्-अपादाने क्विप्] 
__1 'making sin weep and fly', N. of a Mantra which destroys sin; fearfully howling (?). 
__2 [अघे व्यसने रोदिति न तत्प्रतीकाराय घटते, क्विप्] one who only weeps in times of calamity, but does not try to get over them. 
-विषः [अघं व्यसनकारि विषं यस्य] a serpent; fearfully venomous (?). 
-शंसः अघस्य शंसः; शंस् भावे अच्] 
__1 indication or reporting of sin. 
__2 [अघं अनिष्टं शंसति इच्छति; शंस्-अण्] a wicked man, such as a thief. 
__3 wicked; sin-destroying (?). 
-शंसिन् a. reporting or telling one's sin or guilt. 
-हारः a noted robber; rumour of guilt (?).
a. Not solid, a hollow moulding; घनं वाप्यघनं वापि कुर्यात्तु शिल्पवित्तमः [[

.]] 
-मानम् Measurement by the interior of a structure; एवं तद् घनमानमुक्तमघनमानं वक्ष्यतेऽधुना [[
a. [अघं लाति नाशयति ला-क] Destroying sin.
Den. P. To sin, to be malicious; to threaten with ruin.
a. Malicious, wicked, sinful, harmful, injurious; अघायुरिन्द्रियारामो मोघं पार्थ स जीवति [[
a. [अघं व्यसनं ऋच्छति; ऋ-णिनि] Suffering from evil or calamity (व्यसनयुक्त) not anointing (?)
a. Not hot, cold; °अंशु, °धामन् the moon whose rays are cold.
